findings.title: Optional structure counting boundary drift during snapping in Python reference oracle
findings.description: Python oracle freezes optional counts at unsnapped cell representative (cx, cz). Snapping to (xx, zz) shifts boundary up to 80 blocks, causing optional structures to cross boundaries and producing score divergence (e.g. 434 vs 422). Crucially, this is an oracle-only bug; native C evaluates optional counts at snapped coordinates.

findings.title: Dynamic worker reusable buffer capacity poisoning causing NULL pointer dereference (SIGSEGV)
findings.description: Capacities dyn_ex_cap and dyn_cells_cap are committed before confirming malloc() success. On allocation failure during seed N, pointers are NULL while capacity is non-zero. On seed N+1, worker skips reallocation and dereferences NULL, causing fatal SIGSEGV.

findings.title: Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) lease validation race and blind overwrite in complete_prepared
findings.description: Lease ownership validation occurs outside transaction prior to file system capacity checks. The subsequent UPDATE ranges SET status='complete' lacks lease preconditions in WHERE clause, allowing stale or reassigned workers to overwrite active leases and double-count seeds in compact mode.

findings.title: Dynamic envelope working buffers completely bypass declared reservation contract (max_buffer_bytes)
findings.description: Dynamic buffers (dyn_prefix, dyn_cells, dyn_ex, etc.) call malloc() directly, bypassing *w->allocated_bytes tracking against max_buffer_bytes. Live heap exceeds cap by 30-40% without error.

findings.title: Web UI stale candidate caching via invariant (count, max(rowid)) signature on in-place UPDATE
findings.description: Cache signature only tracks (count, max(rowid)). In-place updates to candidates (scores, verification state) leave signature invariant, causing web UI to serve stale data indefinitely.

findings.title: In-flight pipeline queue allows active batches to exceed configured inflight limit by 1
findings.description: Premature refill after pending.popleft() submits a new batch while popped batch is still running, resulting in inflight + 1 active batches holding native resources.

findings.title: Replay provider masks candidate selection divergence by bypassing equivalence cell solver
findings.description: ReplayProvider supplies C-chosen dynamic_center directly to evaluate_dynamic_seed, which completely bypasses candidate_centers and score ranking, creating a circular verification check.

findings.title: Discovered anchors count discrepancy in dynamic retention receipts
findings.description: In dynamic mode, v->anchors records r->nanchors (retained anchors) instead of r->discovery.n because p->origin is 0, causing receipt discovered_anchors to undercount discovered strongholds.

findings.title: Synthetic fixtures silently truncate optional structure inventories in dynamic survivor evaluation
findings.description: nb_dynamic_optional contains 'if(w->fixture)return 0;'. Synthetic fixtures unconditionally return zero optional structures.

findings.title: Missing lease validation in complete_range
findings.description: complete_range calls complete_prepared with lease=None, skipping lease ownership checks.

findings.title: Deferred transactions in claim_range cause IntegrityError under concurrency
findings.description: claim_range uses 'with self.db:' (deferred) rather than _immediate_transaction, risking simultaneous reads of next_index and crashing with UNIQUE constraint failures.

findings.title: Web server global lock starvation during sweep pause/stop blocking waits
findings.description: SweepManager holds self.lock across blocking subprocess wait() calls (up to 30s), freezing all GET /api/sweep/status polling clients.

findings.title: Documentation contradiction in README.md for Bastion milestone and Shipwreck surplus scoring
findings.description: README.md claims '20 per Bastion above three' and '5 per qualifying Shipwreck above five'. Code awards a one-time milestone of +20 pts at >= 3 Bastions, and +5 pts per Shipwreck above six.

findings.title: Monotonic reservation counter allocated_bytes permanently incremented on allocation check rejection
findings.description: *w->allocated_bytes is incremented before checking against max_buffer_bytes; failed allocations do not decrement the counter.

findings.title: Asymmetric allocation failure memory leak in dyn_ex / dyn_ez
findings.description: If malloc(ex_need) succeeds for dyn_ex but fails for dyn_ez, dyn_ex is orphaned and leaked.

findings.title: Absence of native resource finalizer / destructor in Batch class
findings.description: Batch lacks __del__ method; if an unmanaged batch instance is garbage collected without close(), native memory leaks.

findings.title: Asymmetric Nether biome witness representation in NBAnchor
findings.description: NBAnchor lacks nether_biome_mask and nether_first_witness fields, tracking Nether biomes only via raw point coordinates and IDs.

findings.title: WAL checkpoint blockage under long concurrent readers
findings.description: Lack of explicit PRAGMA wal_checkpoint(TRUNCATE) on store close risks unbounded WAL growth if unexhausted readers hold read transactions.

findings.title: Fragile cross-thread RealmStore sharing violates connection thread confinement
findings.description: persist_pipeline passes store instance across threads; while current prepare avoids DB queries, any accidental query throws sqlite3.ProgrammingError under check_same_thread=True.

findings.title: Unsynchronized _runs_cache mutation under concurrent HTTP requests
findings.description: SweepManager.list_runs mutates self._runs_cache without lock synchronization in multi-threaded HTTP server.

findings.title: Lazy Generator Seeding in Dynamic Pipeline
findings.description: Defers applySeed for Overworld generator until after raw mansion preflight, and Nether generator until immediately before nb_nether. Yields ~10.0% kernel speedup while preserving 100% bitwise receipt fingerprint parity, full64 seed identity, and survivor evidence parity.
